description: A queued non-ARQ C_PDU whose TTL expires before it is sent is dropped at its TTD; the next one is still sent, and takes C_PDU ID 0.
note: Conn 1 binds SAP 5 for non-ARQ. At 0 it sends "first" with TTL 1 (2 s, so TTD 2000, A-0089) and then "second" with TTL 0 (TTD 1296000000). The DTS keeps one dts.ttd timer at the earliest TTD of the queue (C-1050): started at 2000 ms for the first request; the second's TTD is later, so no output. The MAC starts csma.lbt_wait 30000. Another station's burst starts at 1000 (no D_PDU decoded): the LBT timer is cancelled while busy (K-0077, K-0087). At 2000 dts.ttd expires: the first C_PDU's TTL has expired, so it is dropped and never transmitted (C-0857, C-0864) and rejected to the CAS with reason TTL expired (C-0859, C-1050), which produces no SIS output because the client asked for no confirmation (A-0105). dts.ttd restarts for the second C_PDU's TTD, 1295998000 ms later. The burst ends at 5000 and LBT restarts with lbt_wait_dcd_ms 30000; seed 0 draws slot 15 (45000). At 80000 the second C_PDU goes out alone as one type 7 D_PDU with C_PDU ID 0: IDs are given when a C_PDU is first placed, so the dropped one used none (C-0326, C-1040). Placing it empties the queue, so dts.ttd is cancelled first. Duration 5550 ms, EOT and window 10.
